en.title: Do the Boeing 747-8 and 787 Dreamliner really share the same engine?
en.summary: The 747-8 and the 787 Dreamliner do share an engine family — the GEnx — but each flies a different variant: the GEnx-2B for the 747-8 and the GEnx-1B, unique to the 787. They share a high-pressure core and about 80% of line-replaceable units, yet each is optimised for a four-engine or twin-engine airframe.
body: It is true that both the 747-8, the final iteration of the Boeing double-decker, and the 787 Dreamliner, its latest clean-sheet design, use the same engine. However, each aircraft uses a different variation of that same turbofan, tailored to its unique needs. The 747-8 exclusively uses the GEnx-2B, while the 787 Dreamliner is the only jetliner ever equipped with the GEnx-1B. Boeing chose the GEnx for the 747-8 primarily to modernise the ageing jumbo jet with next-generation technology.

The GEnx-1B and GEnx-2B share a common high-pressure core and 80% of their Line Replaceable Units, but they are distinct engines optimised for different aircraft architectures. The most fundamental difference is how the engines interact with the aircraft's internal systems: the 787 uses a bleedless architecture where most systems are powered electrically, while the 747-8 uses a traditional bleed-air system, requiring the GEnx-2B to include bleed-air ports, with fewer stages in the booster and low-pressure turbine. To fit the 747's wing and ground clearance, the GEnx-2B has a smaller fan diameter, 105 inches, compared with the 787's 111 inches, and produces roughly 66,500 lbs of thrust. Both engines feature distinctive serrated chevrons on the nacelles, which mix hot exhaust with cool air to significantly reduce noise. Both offer approximately 15% better fuel efficiency than the older CF6 engines they replaced, and the GEnx family is designed to stay on wing 20% longer than previous generations, with some fleet leaders exceeding 30,000 hours without a major overhaul. Tom Levin, General Manager of the GEnx/CF6 engine product line at GE Aviation, commented when the 1,000th GEnx engine was developed in 2015: “The GEnx was the fastest selling engine in GE’s history, and now it is the fastest production ramp up of a GE widebody engine program. The GEnx engine has proven itself with outstanding performance and reliability.”

For airlines that operate both the 787 and 747-8, using the same engine family simplifies maintenance, parts inventory and technician training. But the Dreamliner is the more efficient widebody: the 747 uses about 3,800 gallons of fuel per hour, while the 787 uses about 2,900 gallons, and the 787-9 uses approximately 2.31 litres per 100 km per passenger, significantly better than the 747-8's 2.82 litres. The 787's composite airframe is 50% by weight and 80% by volume, giving it a cabin altitude of 6,000 feet against the 747's 8,000 feet, and humidity of 15%, double that of legacy jets. Lufthansa still operates the 747-8 but has added the 787-9 for flights needing the same range with about 70–90 fewer people, and British Airways switched to the 787-10 for key transatlantic flights to New York and Chicago after retiring its 747 fleet; the 787-10 is 25% more fuel-efficient than the 747 while offering comparable cargo capacity. The 747-8 saw limited passenger orders before the 747 assembly line fully shut down in 2023, while the Dreamliner has become the best-selling widebody in history.

zh.title: 波音747-8與787夢幻客機真的用同一具發動機嗎？GEnx同源不同命
zh.summary: 747-8與787夢幻客機確實共用GEnx發動機家族，但各自搭載不同衍生型：747-8專用GEnx-2B，787則是唯一配備GEnx-1B的客機；兩者共用高壓核心與約八成可更換組件，卻為四發與雙發架構各自最佳化。
body: 答案是肯定的，但只說對了一半。波音747-8與787夢幻客機確實使用同一發動機家族GEnx，不過各自搭載不同衍生型：747-8專用GEnx-2B，787則是歷來唯一配備GEnx-1B的客機。兩者共用高壓核心與約八成可更換組件，波音當初為747-8選用GEnx，是為了以新一代技術為老牌巨無霸升級。GE航空指出，GEnx是該公司史上銷售最快的發動機，也是寬體發動機計畫中量產爬坡最快的一款。

兩款發動機最根本的差異在於如何與飛機系統互動。787採用無引氣架構，多數系統以電力驅動；747-8沿用傳統引氣系統，需從壓縮器抽取高壓空氣驅動客艙增壓與熱防冰等氣動系統，因此GEnx-2B設有引氣接口，增壓器與低壓渦輪級數也較少。為配合747機翼與地面淨空，GEnx-2B風扇直徑105英寸，小於787的111英寸；四發分攤推力也讓2B型單具推力約66,500磅，低於雙發787所需的推力水準。兩款發動機短艙後緣都有鋸齒狀結構，可讓高溫排氣與冷空氣更平順混合，大幅降低噪音。GEnx的燃油效率比被取代的CF6發動機提升約15%，設計上可在機翼停留時間比前代延長20%，部分機隊領先發動機已逾30,000小時未經大修。

對同時營運兩款機型的航空公司而言，共用發動機家族可簡化維修、零件庫存與技師訓練。不過787憑輕量雙發複合材料機身，在廣體客機市場效率明顯勝出：747每小時耗油約3,800加侖，787約2,900加侖；787-9每名乘客每100公里約耗油2.31公升，優於747-8的2.82公升。787的複合材料機身重量占比50%、體積占比80%，客艙高度僅6,000英尺，遠低於747的8,000英尺，濕度達15%，約為傳統客機兩倍。漢莎航空仍營運747-8，同時引進787-9執飛相同航程但少70至90名乘客的航班；英國航空則以787-10取代747執飛紐約與芝加哥等重要跨大西洋航線，787-10比747省油25%，貨運容量相當。747-8客運訂單有限，747總裝線已於2023年全面關閉，787則成為史上最暢銷廣體客機。
